This '''battle''' was contested in the [[Tionese War]], between the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]]. Coming off of victories at [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]] and [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]], the Tionese were successful in conquering [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]].
